transcript: I was born in a Christian family. I was raised in a Christian way. I think Islam is a lie, because that's something I used to say. Islam is a lie, the Quran is poison. Already thought, okay, these Muslim guys are kind of crazy, and this religion isn't the truth. So it wasn't my eyes that were blind. It was really my heart. I couldn't accept it. I think my nafs or my nefs or whatever, my ego, I couldn't accept it. And I decided to write an anti-Islam book, which started as an anti-Islam book, changed into this search for God, and it ended up me becoming a Muslim. So I thought to myself, okay, this is going in the wrong direction. His life was the Quran. He was the living Quran, in a way. Just study his Sunnah, and I think that is the best way of discovering Islam. I couldn't sleep for it for two days. I couldn't accept it. It was so, so strange. And that, yeah, it made me feel very happy.
metadata_caption: While Writing Anti-Islam Book He Became Muslim! | #shorts
